summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend e2e testing of AuraTech laptop e-commerce. All 19 backend API tests pass (catalog, auth, cart, wishlist, coupon, orders). Frontend critical flows verified end-to-end: homepage, shop grid + sidebar filters, product detail with specs bento, login (customer/customer1234), add-to-cart, cart drawer, checkout with SAVE10 coupon (10% off applied correctly), place order → /orders/{id} with PENDING status timeline, cart auto-cleared, wishlist empty state, mobile responsive hamburger drawer. Dark theme #050505 + neon green #00FF66 design renders cleanly with no console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Server.py is 636 lines (mock service) — acceptable as a single-purpose preview mock, but could be split into routers if extended.
Frontend uses CORS allow_origins='*' on the FastAPI mock — fine for preview but tighten for prod (Spring backend likely already enforces).
JWT_SECRET default 'auratech-super-secret-key' should always come from env in prod; current mock is fine.
test_credentials: customer / customer1234 (CUSTOMER), admin / admin1234 (ADMIN). Saved to /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: Backend mock auto-seeds 16 products, 8 brands, 6 categories, 4 coupons, 2 users on startup. No external seeding needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is FastAPI MOCK at /app/backend/server.py mimicking Spring Boot contract. All /api/v1/* endpoints work. Auth token stored in localStorage as 'auratech_token'. Login testids: login-username-input/login-password-input/login-submit-btn. PDP testids: add-to-cart-detail-btn, buy-now-btn, wishlist-detail-btn, qty-increment/decrement. Checkout testids: checkout-name/phone/address/city, payment-cod/vnpay, coupon-input/coupon-apply-btn, place-order-btn. Coupon SAVE10 (10%, no min), SAVE15 (15%, min $200), OFF100 ($100, min $800), AURA200 ($200, min $1500). Run tests: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest /app/backend/tests/test_auratech_api.py -v
